captures.title: Login
captures.shows: The DataHub sign-in page this session authenticated against.

captures.title: Home
captures.shows: The authenticated landing page: platform tiles and entity counts for the catalog this session ingested.

captures.title: Search
captures.shows: Free-text search across all entity types, with the facet rail DataHub builds from the live index.

captures.title: Browse
captures.shows: Hierarchical browse paths, derived by DataHub from the ingested platform/database/schema structure.

captures.title: Dataset
captures.shows: A dataset entity page: platform, description, owners, tags and domain, all read from the catalog.

captures.title: Dataset schema
captures.shows: The schema DataHub holds for the dataset — field paths, native types and nullability as ingested from Postgres.

captures.title: Lineage graph
captures.shows: The lineage graph: stg_users and stg_orders into the feature table, then through the training job to the churn model. Every edge was ingested from the running stack; none was hand-authored.

captures.title: Column lineage
captures.shows: The same graph with column detail expanded — the field-level mapping DataHub's dbt source derived from the manifest dbt itself produced.

captures.title: Impact analysis
captures.shows: DataHub's own impact analysis over the same graph DevGuard's Pathfinder walks for blast radius.

captures.title: Dataset profile / stats
captures.shows: Dataset profile: row and column counts and per-column statistics, profiled from the live database during ingestion.

captures.title: Assertions / quality
captures.shows: The assertions surface DevGuard's Referee reads for independent recovery corroboration.

captures.title: Domains
captures.shows: Domains — the governance grouping DevGuard resolves alongside ownership.

captures.title: Business glossary
captures.shows: The business glossary as this instance holds it.

captures.title: Tags
captures.shows: Tag entities, including `devguard_incident_impacted`. That one is provisioned by scripts/provision_catalog.py, not minted by the agent: `add_tags` fails against a tag URN that does not exist, and the Scribe deliberately does not create one.

captures.title: Policies
captures.shows: The policy list DevGuard's least-privilege service account is scoped by.

captures.title: ML model metadata
captures.shows: The ML model at the end of the blast radius, read as an entity rather than counted as a URN.

captures.title: Ingestion sources
captures.shows: DataHub's ingestion surface. The substrate was ingested with the committed recipes rather than through this screen, so this shows the platform capability, not the path used.

captures.title: Analytics
captures.shows: DataHub's built-in usage analytics over this instance.
